definition: Feeling abandoned, miserable, and unlikely to find comfort.
author: Jane Austen
quote: It had been a very happy fortnight, and forlorn must be the sinking from it into the common course of Hartfield days.
example_sentence: A forlorn teddy bear sat on the empty bench.
